mapper.select: SELECT cap->>'code' code,cap->>'resource_type' resource_type,cap->>'risk_level' risk_level,COALESCE(s.disabled,false) disabled, COALESCE(l.state,'ACTIVE') lifecycle_state,COALESCE(l.version,0) lifecycle_version,l.reason lifecycle_reason FROM auth_governance.application_catalog a JOIN auth_governance.application_manifest m ON m.application_id=a.application_id AND m.version=a.manifest_version CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements(m.manifest_json::jsonb->'capabilities') cap LEFT JOIN auth_governance.capability_lifecycle l ON l.application_id=a.application_id AND l.capability=cap->>'code' LEFT JOIN auth_governance.capability_state s ON s.application_id=a.application_id AND s.capability=cap->>'code' WHERE a.application_id=#{app} ORDER BY cap->>'code'

WITH refs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM auth_governance.retirement_references(#{app},#{cap})), limited AS (SELECT * FROM refs ORDER BY kind,id,COALESCE(tenant_id,''),COALESCE(environment,'') LIMIT 10000), counts AS (SELECT kind,count(*) FILTER(WHERE blocking) blocking,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT blocking) historical FROM refs GROUP BY kind) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM refs) total, COALESCE((SELECT md5(string_agg(kind||':'||id||':'||COALESCE(tenant_id,'')||':'||COALESCE(environment,'')||':'||blocking||':'||fingerprint,'|' ORDER BY kind,id,COALESCE(tenant_id,''),COALESCE(environment,''))) FROM limited),md5('')) reference_hash, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY kind)::text FROM counts c),'[]') counts_json,clock_timestamp()::text checked_at

SELECT kind,id,blocking,state,role_id,source_type,valid_to::text FROM auth_governance.retirement_references(#{p.applicationId},#{cap}) WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND environment=#{p.environment} AND (kind,id)>(#{kind},#{after}) ORDER BY kind,id LIMIT 101

choose.when: SELECT to_jsonb(d)::text FROM auth_governance.access_delegation d WHERE d.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND d.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND d.environment=#{p.environment} AND d.membership_id=#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT to_jsonb(p)::text FROM auth_governance.request_policy p WHERE p.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND p.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND p.environment=#{p.environment} AND p.id=#{id}

choose.when: UPDATE auth_governance.access_delegation SET enabled=false WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND environment=#{p.environment} AND membership_id=#{id} AND enabled
choose.otherwise: UPDATE auth_governance.request_policy SET enabled=false WHERE tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND environment=#{p.environment} AND id=#{id} AND enabled
